description: An Azure DevOps .NET 8 MSIX WPF build fails with NETSDK1112 because win-x64 runtime packs were not restored, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/77644744/net-8-in-azure-devops-gives-error-netsdk1112-the-runtime-pack-for-microsoft-n.
prompt: Since upgrading our MSIX WPF app from .NET 7 to .NET 8, Azure DevOps fails even though it works locally. The hosted Windows agent has .NET 8 installed, but the build says `Error NETSDK1112: The runtime pack for Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x64 was not downloaded. Try running a NuGet restore with the RuntimeIdentifier 'win-x64'.` and the same for `Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App.Runtime.win-x64`.
